description: This Java source file defines the class MimeMessageWrapper, which provides a serializable wrapper around the javax.mail.internet.MimeMessage class. It offers methods to access email message properties, headers, content, attachments, and handling of serialization/deserialization of email messages within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MimeMessageWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for MimeMessage that supports serialization and provides utility methods to access email message properties, headers, content, and attachments within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the email session and updates mail properties.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the email session, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Serializes the provided MimeMessage and updates internal state, including part count.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Deserializes and returns the MimeMessage, if not already loaded.

methods.name: getFirstHeader
methods.description: Returns the first value of the specified header.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns all values for the specified header.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the sender addresses.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the recipient addresses in the 'To' field.

methods.name: getCc
methods.description: Returns the CC recipient addresses.

methods.name: getBcc
methods.description: Returns the BCC recipient addresses.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Returns the message ID.

methods.name: getSentDate
methods.description: Returns the date the email was sent, as a Timestamp.

methods.name: getReceivedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the email was received, as a Timestamp.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message.

methods.name: getMainPartCount
methods.description: Returns the number of main parts of the email message.

methods.name: getSubPartCount
methods.description: Returns the number of subparts within a specified part index.

methods.name: getAttachmentIndexes
methods.description: Returns a list of indexes for attachments and inline parts.

methods.name: getMessageBody
methods.description: Retrieves the plain text body of the email message.

methods.name: getMessageBodyContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message body, prioritizing text parts.

methods.name: getMessageRawText
methods.description: Returns the raw text of the message input stream.

methods.name: getPartDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of a specific part indicated by index.

methods.name: getPartContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the specified part.

methods.name: getPartDisposition
methods.description: Returns the disposition (attachment/inline) of the specified part.

methods.name: getPartFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with a part.

methods.name: getPartByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns the byte buffer content of the part.

methods.name: getPartText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the specified part.

methods.name: getPartRawText
methods.description: Returns the raw text of the specified part from its input stream.

methods.name: getPart
methods.description: Retrieves a BodyPart object based on the string index, supporting nested parts.

methods.name: getContentText
methods.description: Helper method to extract text from various types of content objects.

methods.name: getTextFromStream
methods.description: Reads an InputStream and converts it to a String.

methods.name: getByteBufferFromStream
methods.description: Reads an InputStream and returns its content as a ByteBuffer.
